title: Graceful Deceleration Orchestrator for Model & Dependency Fuses
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and implement an orchestrator that applies tenant-, model-, and dependency-scoped circuit behavior with gradual, observable deceleration (soft trips) and safe fallback routing. Goal: reduce hard failovers and noisy rollbacks by introducing time-windowed soft-trip profiles, probabilistic shedding, and deterministic fallback selectors that preserve SLOs across multi-region failovers.
acceptance_criteria: Per-tenant and per-model soft-trip profile can be configured and deployed via API and Console
Trip conditions support multiple signals: p99 latency, p95 latency, error rate, and queue depth with independent windows
Soft-trip triggers probabilistic shedding (configurable probability curve) before full trip and logs decisions to tracing & Console
Fallback routing selects a pinned compatible model variant or region according to policy and honors data residency constraints
Rollouts include canary shadowing: decisions are recorded but not applied for first-stage rollout
Observability: Console shows current trip state, recent trip events, and SLO delta for affected routes/tenants
technical_decisions: Use sliding percentile windows (60s, 5m) per tenant/model to compute signals; maintain EWMA for smoothing spikes
Introduce a soft-trip state that accepts a configurable deceleration curve: initial probability p0 then ramp to p_max over T seconds
Implement hysteresis with rejoin probes (exponential backoff) to avoid oscillation; rejoin requires stable window below recovery thresholds for 2x window

Fallback selector tries in order: pinned variant -> cheaper quantized variant (if quality delta within tolerance) -> regional replica -> best-effort hosted fallback; all with metadata-driven constraints
Routing changes must be atomic and idempotent; use roll-forward tokens to ensure safe retries during orchestration
Telemetry emitted: trip_event, shed_decision, fallback_choice, rejoin_probe with tenant/model tags and SLO snapshot
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (canary shadow): enable soft-trip logic in shadow mode for <1% traffic across us-east-1, eu-west-1 for 48h; collect telemetry
Phase 1 (limited apply): apply soft-trip at 1% of traffic for select non-critical tenants for 24h monitoring
Phase 2 (regional ramp): enable 10%/50%/100% staged across regions, observe SLO deltas and error budgets
Phase 3 (global): turn on default soft-trip profiles for all tenants with per-tenant opt-out; monitor for 2 weeks
Safety rollback: immediate disable global soft-trip and revert to previous routing if error budget burn > 1% in 10min or p99 latency regression > 30%
testing_plan: Unit tests for signal aggregation and probability curve calculations
Integration tests: simulate high p95 and verify probabilistic shedding frequency matches profile
Chaos staging: inject latency and error spikes in staging across region replicas and validate fallback correctness and SLO reporting
Load test: per-tenant load ramp to verify queue depth thresholds and backpressure interactions with autoscaler
E2E validation: Console shows trip events and rejoin probes; run manual playbook to exercise rollback and canary promotion
